description: Fork of exp154 (BitAttention reference, val_bpb=1.7105). H=12 (was 6), d_qk=32 (unchanged), d_v=16 (halved). qk_tph=256 (was 384) and v_tph=128 (was 256). H*d_qk doubles (192→384) so Q/K total dim grows; H*d_v stays at 192 so out_proj input dim unchanged. Total budget ~430M (+10% vs exp154's 392M). Per-head dominance vector P_qk = d_qk*(d_qk-1)/2 = 496 (unchanged). BitAttention runs on 12 heads at P=496 instead of 6 heads — 2x more attention compute. Tests whether more heads with rich Q/K + cheaper V improves over fewer wide-V heads.
